title: Albeda Coker
clean_html:
Albeda Coker

Preserved Primary Document • coker-a4.htm

Albeda Coker was the daughter of Moses Coker and Mary Ann Dean . She was born in Kent Co., DE on 1 April, 1878. She was married first to Cassius MOSLEY and then to Calvin CLARK. Calvin was born in Millsboro, Sussex Co., DE on 22 October, 1887, the son of William Clark and Flornece Drain. He became the undertaker for the Kent Co. community. Calvin and Albeda had at least one child : Edna Clark Albeda died on 24 March, 1953 . Calvin died on 20 August 1970. Both are buried at Fork Branch Church near Cheswold in Kent Co., DE.
